facts.fact: 两天前爆炸后 artificers 工坊已清理，现场没有喊叫、伤者或碎玻璃；Anero 说 Clement 治好了她的脑震荡，自己 good as new
facts.anchor: workshop had been cleaned since the explosion two days ago

facts.fact: Anero 提到同事 Artificer Floris Decroy 的死时声音中断；Clement 想到他死状暴烈、消息传得快，克制住没去拍她肩膀
facts.anchor: Floris Decroy’s violent manner of death would have made for rapid gossip

facts.fact: Clement 告诉 Anero：他们确信 Ysabel 是被谋杀、Estiene 是被栽赃；Anero 说 Marcelle 那男孩不像会为鲁莽之事拿前途冒险的人
facts.anchor: never struck me as the type to risk his future with something so rash

facts.fact: Anero 说她昨天不在场；Decroy 是最后离开大楼的人，愿意的话本可留下逐条复核法术
facts.anchor: He was the last of us in the building.

facts.fact: Anero 从腰间钥匙串上取下一把系红丝带的钥匙，说它能开 North Wing 所有门；Clement 答我不是从你这儿拿的
facts.anchor: pulled a red-ribboned key from a bunch at her belt

facts.fact: 学生研究架上没有 Ysabel 的文件夹；Clement 在最底层上锁抽屉里看到黄色物件，大小正像 Ysabel 的笔记本，还能辨出一个大的、手写名字开头的 Y
facts.anchor: a large swooping Y, the beginning of a handwritten name

facts.fact: Brodier 回来撞见 Clement，目光扫向抽屉，说第四场 case 在一小时多一点之后，并说考前接触考官显得很不专业
facts.anchor: Your fourth case is in—just over an hour

facts.fact: Brodier 说周底一切都会明白，并上前把手覆在 Clement 手上；Clement 手上有新刮伤，怕她察觉自己脉搏狂跳
facts.anchor: everything will make sense at the end of the week
